text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ wins the spring Tenno
Sho. But
even so, the racing world still
sees her as no more
than Нарита Брайан's
sister.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
If the venue for the race hadn't been
changed,
Biwa Hayahide could've
maximized the results of
her equation
and put on an even better

performance...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But she reminds me that there's no use
dwelling
on something we had no
control over and urges
me to focus on
the future instead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the exclusive
Takarazuka Kinen,
where only the best
are chosen to race. We begin
working
hard so Бива Хаяхидэ can show the

racing world just how strong she is.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
